title: Uporny, the stubborn tiger

scenes.headline: The tiger who wouldn't leave his cage
A starving young male tiger is eating village dogs
scenes.body: Instead of a zoo, he is captured and sent to the Utyos rehabilitation centre in Russia's Far East.

scenes.headline: GPS-collared, he settled near Anyuisky National Park
scenes.body: He wandered for about six weeks first. A 'conflict tiger' got a second chance in the wild.

caption:
His name means 'stubborn'. It fits.

Uporny's release was run by the Khabarovsk hunting department's tiger-conflict team with the Amur Tiger Center and WWF-Russia, and his collar let researchers follow him for most of two years.

Source: WWF Tigers Alive; Amur Tiger Center.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Named-individual storytime using WWF's own release footage of a 3-year-old conflict tiger (Commons description matches WWF's May 2015 Uporny story); the cage-to-bolt clip pays off the hook.
